description: # Lectures. ## Lecture Timetables. ## Lecture Synopses. Each lecture course has a brief synopsis and recommended reading list. PDF 2025/26 MS Prelims Lecture Course Synopses. PDF 2025/26 MS Finals Core Lecture Course Synopses. PDF 2025/26 MS Finals Option Lecture Course Synopses. ## Options Classes. These are classes organised by lecturers to supplement the teaching of options courses. Students' work for options classes is assessed by the lecturer after the class. These assessments form a central part of the reporting about options classes to colleges. For options class timetable see lecturelists timetable. Students attend one class in each set and need to register for a specific class via the sign-up tool on Canvas. ## Lecture Notes. Supporting materials for lectures are available via Oxford's virtual learning environment Canvas. Please email the webmaster if you have suggested modifications/additions.
